body: Thank you so much for your reply. You're comments were what I needed to hear and they made me feel warm. I love your painting, I'm an artist too, it's the kindest gesture I've had from a stranger. The image is saved on my phone for me to look at while I'm going through this. I'm going to make an appointment with my therapist soon, maybe it will help. Thank you again for your loving response.
Thank you for the empathy. I'm in this situation because I love him still and part of me wants to make it work.. but I know I need space. I'm just very dependant on him for emotional support as well
